CustomField.label: If Query Finds No Records
CustomField.description: What the check should do when the "Source Query" returns no records. No default - you must choose, because Pass versus Fail can invert the meaning of a check. Required when "How To Read Query Results" is "Any record passes", "Every record passes", or "Compare as lists". Choices: "Pass" (no records is healthy), "Fail" (no records is a problem), "Skip" (not applicable here), or "Unable to evaluate" (cannot tell). Example: a query for open high-priority cases finding none usually means the record is healthy, so choose "Pass".
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Required for multi-row and list checks. Choose the business meaning of no matching records: Pass, Fail, Skip, or Unable to evaluate.
